conclusion.en: New local evidence narrows identity, utility and traffic questions. Retail analogues support testing demand, while current demand charges weaken generic low-electricity-cost cases. No site is investment-ready.
conclusion.zh: 新的本地证据缩小了地块、供电及交通疑问。零售类比支持验证需求，而当前需量费用削弱了低电价假设。仍无场地具备投资资格。

method.en: The dated tariff cases retain v0.7 gross costs, prices, ramp, losses and stress factors; they replace the supplier all-in electricity proxy with published charges and explicit peak assumptions. They are incomplete-bill sensitivities, not full-cost forecasts.
method.zh: 定日电价情景保留v0.7总成本、售价、爬坡、损耗及压力参数，用公布费用和明确峰值假设替代厂家全包电价。它们是未完整电费敏感度，不是完整成本预测。

boundary.en: No probability of investment success is estimated. All transfer cases assume every reference session is billable; observed paid mix and session energy are missing. Tariff taxes, reactive power, bespoke fees and control costs are unresolved, so positive results are conditional and can overstate returns. Existing investment admission is unchanged.
boundary.zh: 不估算投资成功概率。类比情景假定参照会话全部付费，但真实付费比例及每次电量未知。税、无功、特殊费用和控制成本未定，因此正向结果有条件且可能高估收益。原投资准入保持不变。

claim.en: A Q4 2025 study of 4,105 non-Tesla high-power stations reports median sessions of 42/site/day near grocery stores and 9 overall.
claim.zh: 一项覆盖2025年第四季度4,105处非Tesla大功率站的研究报告：超市邻近站会话中位数为每站每天42次，全样本9次。

limitation.en: Reported analytics, not audited sales; Paren separately discloses proprietary session modeling, while this older cohort counting method is unpublished. Grocery sample size, port mix, paid fraction and kWh are unpublished; prevalence inconsistencies are excluded. Publishers share one dataset.
limitation.zh: 这是报告分析，非审计销售；Paren另有专有会话建模披露，但较早本样本的计数方法未公开。超市子样本规模、枪数、付费比例及电量未知；已排除矛盾占比。发布者共用同一数据。

claim.en: Selected Publix Cambridge Square example reports median 59 sessions/site/day across five ports; retained AFDC data matches the five-port Atlanta address.
claim.zh: 精选Publix Cambridge Square案例报告五枪每站每天会话中位数59次；保留的AFDC数据匹配该亚特兰大五枪地址。

limitation.en: Selected successful comparator, not a local matched sample. Transferring its whole-site count onto four posts is a separate assumption, not measured per-port demand.
limitation.zh: 这是精选高表现参照，非本地匹配样本。将整站会话数转移到四枪是额外假设，非实测单枪需求。

claim.en: Iowa DOT lists Tesla project budgets of $493,904 at Shelby and $624,920 at Lamoni separately from grants of $345,732.80 and $437,444.
claim.zh: Iowa DOT分别列出Tesla在Shelby和Lamoni的项目预算493,904和624,920美元，补助为345,732.80和437,444美元。

limitation.en: 2024 award-stage nominal budgets, not invoices or matching local four-post quotes. The program requires at least four concurrent 150 kW ports; exact design, excluded works and operating-cost allocation are unreconciled. No subsidy is transferred.
limitation.zh: 这是2024年授标阶段名义预算，非发票或匹配当地四枪报价。项目至少四枪同时150kW，但具体设计、未包含工程及运营费用分配未核；不转用这些补助。

claim.en: A completed EVgo California retail-project report states that opening took more than two years. A two-year total construction sensitivity is now shown alongside the one-year base case.
claim.zh: 一份EVgo加州零售已建项目报告称投用耗时超过两年。现加入两年建设期敏感度，对照一年基准。

limitation.en: A grantee report from another state, not the local connection schedule. Public report lists collected data fields but not a usable paid-demand/cost series.
limitation.zh: 这是外州受助方报告，不是当地接电进度。公开报告列明数据字段，但没有可用的付费需求或成本序列。

change.en: Parcel uncertainty reduced; electricity underwriting becomes more demanding. First priority remains conditional on a costed load profile.
change.zh: 地块身份更明确，但电费承销要求提高。仍优先调查，须有可定价的负荷方案。

claim.en: WCAD parcel R600635 matches the retailer address; appraisal owner is BAR W MARKETPLACE LLC. County and official retailer records support Georgetown 78628; a City of Austin record uses Leander 78641 for the same store #774.
claim.zh: WCAD地块R600635匹配门店地址，评估登记业主为BAR W MARKETPLACE LLC。县及零售商记录使用Georgetown 78628，Austin市记录对同一774号店使用Leander 78641。

limitation.en: This reduces the postal-alias concern, not legal title, charging rights or validation of the vendor map point.
limitation.zh: 这降低邮政别名疑点，但不证明法律产权、充电权或厂家地图点准确。

claim.en: TxDOT station 246HP1483 on Ronald Reagan reports 23,799 AADT for 2025, versus 25,021 in 2024; the point is about 348 m from the retained site coordinate.
claim.zh: TxDOT的Ronald Reagan道路计数点246HP1483在2025年报告AADT为23,799，2024年为25,021；距保留场地点约348米。

limitation.en: Roadway volume is not EV traffic, store visits or paid sessions. Do not add adjacent SH29 counts or assume demand growth.
limitation.zh: 道路总流量不等于电动车、到店量或付费订单；不能叠加相邻SH29车流或自动假设需求增长。

claim.en: PUCT published polygons indicate PEC at the retained point. Current PEC Large Power rates include monthly peak charges and transmission charges that change after a new account establishes its summer 4CP.
claim.zh: PUCT公开图层将保留坐标指向PEC。当前大功率电价包含月峰值费用，新账户建立夏季4CP后，输电收费方式会改变。

limitation.en: PUCT labels its boundaries unofficial. Meter identity, capacity/date, municipal fees, tax and the actual interval profile remain unverified; a 600 kW model parameter is not an offered service.
limitation.zh: PUCT声明边界非正式；电表归属、容量及日期、市政费用、税和实际分时负荷均待核。600kW只是模型参数，不是供电承诺。

claim.en: PEC connection rules can require applicant-funded feeder, transformer and substation work. The economic-development discount requires at least 2.2 million qualifying kWh and agreements; the four-post vendor reference is below that energy threshold.
claim.zh: PEC接电规则可能要求申请方承担馈线、变压器及变电站工程。经济发展折扣要求至少220万符合条件的kWh及协议；四枪厂家参照电量低于该门槛。

limitation.en: No complete connection or EPC quote, award or lease was obtained. No discount is booked. Store-meter aggregation cannot be assumed.
limitation.zh: 未取得完整接电或EPC报价、补助或租约；不计折扣，不假定可合并门店电表。

next.en: Obtain a landlord-approved charger boundary, PEC meter and service design, 15-minute load/4CP assumptions, and a complete cost ledger before ordering a study.
next.zh: 先取得业主批准的充电区域、PEC电表及供电设计、15分钟负荷/4CP假设和完整成本清单，再考虑付费研究。

limitation.en: Uniform energy across local clock hours is assumed (122 summer, 153 shoulder, 90 winter days), not measured. A full first operating year on new-account energy TCOS is a startup-calendar assumption; actual transition is January after the first 4CP summer. Later years hold the stated previous-summer 4CP and current rates constant. Sales/franchise taxes, bespoke charges and control costs are excluded. Lower 4CP requires feasible interval operations and may reduce sales.
limitation.zh: 假设本地各时钟小时电量均匀（夏122天、过渡153天、冬90天），并非实测。首个运营年全用新账户电量TCOS是开业日历假设；实际在首个4CP夏季后的1月切换。后续固定指定上年夏季4CP和当前费率。未计销售/特许税、特殊费用和控制费。较低4CP需要可执行分时运营，且可能损失销量。

limitation.en: Uniform energy across local clock hours is assumed (122 summer, 153 shoulder, 90 winter days), not measured. A full first operating year on new-account energy TCOS is a startup-calendar assumption; actual transition is January after the first 4CP summer. Later years hold the stated previous-summer 4CP and current rates constant. Sales/franchise taxes, bespoke charges and control costs are excluded. Lower 4CP requires feasible interval operations and may reduce sales.
limitation.zh: 假设本地各时钟小时电量均匀（夏122天、过渡153天、冬90天），并非实测。首个运营年全用新账户电量TCOS是开业日历假设；实际在首个4CP夏季后的1月切换。后续固定指定上年夏季4CP和当前费率。未计销售/特许税、特殊费用和控制费。较低4CP需要可执行分时运营，且可能损失销量。

change.en: Retail hypothesis retained; ordinary high-demand tariff weakens the case. Prioritize tariff eligibility and peak design before treating this as a high-priority build.
change.zh: 保留零售假设；普通高需量电价削弱经济性。先核实电价资格及峰值设计，再判断新建优先级。

claim.en: The facility point intersects parcel 6025500020 in a public historical GIS copy; a 2021 county hearing names WINCO FOODS LLC and the same parcel.
claim.zh: 设施坐标与公开历史GIS中的6025500020地块相交；2021年县听证记录列出WINCO FOODS LLC及相同地块。

limitation.en: 2018 GIS edit and 2020/2021 assessment records are historical leads, not current title, parking control or a charger layout.
limitation.zh: 2018年GIS编辑与2020/2021年评估记录仅提供历史线索，不是当前产权、停车控制权或充电布局。

claim.en: Pierce County provider polygons return PSE at the Ecology facility point. October 2026 Schedule 26 secondary charges include $0.121947/grid-kWh, $436.32/month, plus winter/summer demand of $17.47/$10.26 per kW-month.
claim.zh: Pierce县供电区域在Ecology设施点返回PSE。2026年10月26号二次侧电价包括每电网kWh 0.121947美元、每月436.32美元，加冬/夏每kW每月17.47/10.26美元需量费。

limitation.en: Mapped provider is conditional. Municipal taxes, reactive charges and special service terms are not priced; peak kW is assumed, not reserved capacity.
limitation.zh: 供电归属仅为地图推断；市政税、无功及特殊服务条款未计价。峰值kW是假设，不是预留容量。

claim.en: WSDOT returns 2025 AADT of 43,000 on nearby SR161 MP20.26–21.34 and 44,000 at counter MP21.69, about 1.1 km northeast of the facility.
claim.zh: WSDOT返回2025年附近SR161里程20.26–21.34路段AADT 43,000；21.69计数点为44,000，距设施东北约1.1公里。

limitation.en: These overlap and must not be added. They are corridor traffic, not entrance counts or EV demand. Layer description says 2023 while returned features explicitly say 2025; unverified county 28,500-year alignment is excluded.
limitation.zh: 数据重叠，不可相加。它们是走廊车流，不是入口计数或电动车需求。图层说明仍写2023，返回要素明确为2025；已排除年份未核的县28,500数据。

claim.en: Schedule 558 current eligibility includes charging stations but participation is capped at 35 delivery points or 3 MW. PSE customer-owned public charging support advertises up to 50% and $40,000/port, subject to program and eligible-cost limits.
claim.zh: 当前558号电价资格包括充电站，但参与上限为35个供电点或3MW。PSE客户自有公共充电支持最高50%及每端口4万美元，受项目和合格费用限制。

limitation.en: Enrollment headroom, owner authority, design/equipment acceptance and written offer are unverified. Four-port $160,000 is only a conditional ceiling; separate upgrade allowances are not automatically additive. Payment follows installation and evidence.
limitation.zh: 名额、业主授权、设计/设备认可及书面报价均未核。四枪16万美元仅为有条件上限；另列扩容额度不可自动叠加。安装及证据完成后才付款。

next.en: Confirm the actual PSE account and separately metered charging design, then compare ordinary service with an accepted Schedule 558 plan using interval loads and the cost of controls.
next.zh: 确认实际PSE账户和独立充电电表设计，以分时负荷及控制成本比较普通电价与获批558方案。

limitation.en: Same 600 kW billed peak in every month; six winter and six summer months. Conditional secondary service above 350 kW. Excludes reactive energy, municipal tax and special contracts; not a full bill or connection offer. Rates held constant, not a ten-year guarantee.
limitation.zh: 假设每月计费峰值均600kW，冬夏各六个月；有条件适用超过350kW二次侧服务。不含无功、市政税和特殊合同，不是完整账单或接电报价。费率保持不变仅为假设，不是十年保证。

label.en: PSE 558 trial · 200 kW peak / 600 kW off-peak

limitation.en: Conditional demand-only RG3 enrollment, not approved. Two separate monthly demand maxima are charged. Holding peak hours (16:00–21:00 except holidays) to 200 kW while retaining sales requires a costed control/queue design. Control costs and lost sessions are excluded. Normalized demand rate is only the stated component sum divided by 600, not a published tariff rate.
limitation.zh: 有条件申请需量模式RG3，尚未获批。分别收取两时段月最大需量。将高峰（节假日除外16–21时）限制为200kW且维持销量，需要有成本的控制/排队设计；控制费及流失订单未计。归一化需量费率仅为分项之和除600，不是官方费率。

change.en: Road context is clearer, but utility overlap and parcel-level access still prevent a site-specific bill. Retain as conditional second priority.
change.zh: 道路背景更明确，但供电区域重叠和地块通行问题仍阻止具体电费定案。保留为有条件的第二优先级。

claim.en: TxDOT US290 station 11H88 reports 40,613 AADT in 2025, versus 47,046 in 2024, about 274 m from the retained point.
claim.zh: TxDOT的US290计数点11H88在2025年报告AADT为40,613，2024年为47,046，距保留坐标约274米。

limitation.en: Annualized road traffic is not charging demand; no locally matched EV share or capture rate was obtained.
limitation.zh: 年化道路流量不是充电需求；未取得匹配当地的电动车占比或捕获率。

claim.en: PUCT polygons intersect both Bluebonnet and Oncor. Official H-E-B uses WEST while CapMetro lists the same #475 store and phone with EAST.
claim.zh: PUCT图层同时覆盖Bluebonnet与Oncor。官方H-E-B使用WEST，CapMetro对同一475号店及电话使用EAST。

limitation.en: Neither an electricity provider nor engineering-record identity is resolved. Do not transplant PEC rates or merge older East-labeled engineering costs.
limitation.zh: 仍未确定供电商或工程记录身份；不可套用PEC电价，也不可合并旧EAST工程成本。

claim.en: The preliminary US290 configuration retains signalized Lee Dildy/11th Street intersections and non-tolled frontage lanes; final schematic/environmental decision is only planned for early 2028.
claim.zh: US290初步方案保留Lee Dildy/11th Street信号交叉口及免费辅路；最终方案和环境决定仅计划于2028年初完成。

limitation.en: This does not establish the H-E-B driveway or right-of-way outcome. The large schematic could not be inspected in this pass; no parcel clearance is claimed.
limitation.zh: 这不证明H-E-B入口或征地结果；本轮未能检查大幅图纸，不声称地块已排除风险。

next.en: Resolve meter/provider and a parcel-level roadway overlay before commissioning a utility or EPC estimate.
next.zh: 先确定电表/供电商，并完成地块级道路叠图，再委托接电或EPC估算。

change.en: Expansion/redesign hypothesis unchanged. The newly checked published commercial rebate is Level 2, not evidence of DCFC funding.
change.zh: 扩建/改造假设不变。新核实的商业补助针对交流二级充电，并非直流快充资助证据。

claim.en: Snohomish PUD commercial EV rebate page specifies qualifying Level 2 ENERGY STAR equipment.
claim.zh: Snohomish PUD商业电动车补助页面明确针对符合条件的ENERGY STAR二级充电设备。

limitation.en: Do not book this as DCFC capital support. This does not prove that no other support exists; existing operator rights, reusable assets and spare capacity remain unresolved.
limitation.zh: 不能将其计为直流快充建设补助；这不证明没有其他支持。现有运营权、可复用资产和剩余容量仍待核。

next.en: Obtain existing operator/host rights, as-built equipment and paid-energy records, then quote incremental work rather than a new full station.
next.zh: 取得现有运营商/业主权利、竣工设备和付费电量，再报价增量工程，而非整站重建。

change.en: Recovery/redesign hypothesis retained. A conditional upgrade rebate route is clearer, but Tesla equipment eligibility is not established.
change.zh: 保留恢复/改造假设。有条件的升级补助路径更明确，但尚未确认Tesla设备资格。

claim.en: Pacific Power allows qualifying upgrades/expansions subject to prior funding. For eligible ≥150 kW ports the rebate is up to 75% of qualifying cost, capped at $30,000/port and normally $100,000/site.
claim.zh: Pacific Power允许符合条件的升级或扩建，并受既往资助限制。符合条件的≥150kW端口最高补助合格费用75%，每端口3万美元，通常每址10万美元封顶。

limitation.en: Four ports do not automatically earn $120,000. Larger amounts need preapproval; listed equipment/network and actual paid invoices are required. No affirmative Tesla V4 listing or award was established.
limitation.zh: 四枪不自动获得12万美元；更高金额需预批准，设备/网络须符合清单并提供已付款发票。未确认Tesla V4在清单中，也未获补助。

next.en: Resolve cancellation, asset/operator rights and eligible equipment before comparing a complete recovery quote with the new-build case.
next.zh: 先解决取消原因、资产/运营权和合格设备，再比较完整恢复报价与新建方案。

tariffMethod.en: Four posts. The unchanged v0.7 three scenarios set gross capital at $634,500 / $564,000 / $517,000; demand at 70% / 100% / 120% of the vendor reference. Published utility components are stressed by +25% only in the conservative case. No grants enter the scenarios. Joint required energy solves both base and conservative rules with downside energy at 70% of the base; it is an optimistic subtotal boundary because unpriced charges remain.
tariffMethod.zh: 四枪；沿用v0.7三情景，总投资634,500/564,000/517,000美元，需求为厂家参照70%/100%/120%。仅保守情景将官方电费分项上调25%。三情景均不计补助。联合所需电量同时满足基准及保守规则，其中保守电量为基准70%；因未计价费用仍存，这只是偏乐观的费用小计边界。

transferMethod.en: 9 / 42 / 59 are external reported station-session references, not local quantiles. Transfer to four posts at assumed 22 or 35 billable kWh/session; 100% of sessions are assumed paid. The 59-session source has five ports, so its four-post transfer assumes different throughput per post. Base cost and dated tariff are held fixed; these are alternatives, not the conservative/base/optimistic investment cases.
transferMethod.zh: 9/42/59是外部报告的整站会话参照，不是本地分位数。转移至四枪并假设每次22或35kWh可计费电量、全部会话付费。59次原案例有五枪，转移到四枪会改变单枪吞吐。固定基准成本与定日电价；这些是替代假设，非投资保守/基准/乐观三情景。
